daily_exports: Energy State - State your mental bandwidth / exhaustion level when entering a shared space.
Micro-Bid Validation - Catch one casual observation, turn toward them, engage for 2+ sentences.
Unfinished Thought - Share one trivial or incomplete idea out loud; narrate, don't solve.
scripts: Status Update - 'My brain is redlined; I'll be quiet to decompress, but glad to be home with you.'
Narration - 'I've been running through thoughts on [Topic]; not solved yet, but a window into my focus.'
Turning Toward - 'Yeah? Tell me a bit more about that.' (+1 follow-up context sentence)
Soft Opening - 'Something's on my mind and you matter to me. Can we carve out 10 calm minutes tonight?'
In-the-Moment Freeze - 'I'm overwhelmed and freezing, but not checking out. Give me two minutes to process.'
